TITLE: Bookmarks
INTRO: Your bookmarks, saved in this browser.
EMPTY: No bookmarks. Open Manage to add one or import a list.
LABEL: Label
CONFIRM_RESET_TO_DEFAULT: Replace all current bookmarks with the default links?
IMPORT_READY: Choose how to import {count} bookmarks. Merge skips exact duplicates; replace removes the current list.
INVALID: Use a non-empty label and an http:// or https:// URL.
INVALID_IMPORT: Invalid file. Expected an array of browser bookmarks with labels and HTTP(S) targets, optional subgroups, and no embed or shell options.
STORAGE_ERROR: Browser storage is unavailable. Changes last only until you reload; export to keep a copy.
